definitions.name: Rolling Volley
definitions.description: Line, cohesion >=70, stationary: reload -20% near a steady infantry ally within 90 m.

definitions.name: Swift Reform
definitions.description: Formation time -25%, manoeuvre disruption -20%, quiet cohesion recovery +35%.

definitions.name: Rallying Presence
definitions.description: Steady officer supports allies within 125 m: +0.30 morale/s, +0.45 while rallying; strongest aura only.

definitions.name: Controlled Charge
definitions.description: Charge turning +20%, alignment +10%, impact disorder -30%, cooldown -20%, reform time -30%.

definitions.name: Relentless Pursuit
definitions.description: Pursuit power +20%; recover 8 cohesion once per enemy routed by this regiment, per battle.

definitions.name: Shock Commander
definitions.description: Forceful charges against exposed enemies inflict +35% morale shock; prepared fronts resist.

definitions.name: Woodland Ambush
definitions.description: First stationary volley from obscured forest cover: +6 morale shock and -8 cohesion. Reset needs 30 s without attacking and a 40 m move.

definitions.name: Harassing Fire
definitions.description: A volley causing casualties removes 3 additional target cohesion; no extra casualty damage.

definitions.name: Steadfast Defence
definitions.description: Stationary, steady defensive line at cohesion >=60: charge resistance +20%, morale shock -20%.

definitions.name: Mobile Battery
definitions.description: Limber and setup times -40%; existing battery AI can finish repositioning sooner.

definitions.name: Calculated Fire
definitions.description: After 6 seconds stationary and deployed: horizontal and vertical aim scatter -35%; moving resets preparation.

definitions.name: Inspired Attack
definitions.description: Damaging wavering/routing enemies inspires visible allies within 100 m for +3 morale; shared army cooldown 20 s.
